svg.text: AI Cordon Intent and “this run” are measured with PIArena's own pipeline; the other rows are the numbers PIArena publishes.
PIArena's third attack, the adaptive “strategy” search, is not measured for AI Cordon Intent and is not in this figure.
Defenses in PIArena: what gets through against what still works
Percent, mean over 13 datasets. Attack success is the mean of the direct and the combined attack. Green marks the good corner.
Attacks that succeeded, % ◄ fewer is better
Utility on clean documents, % ▲ more is better
the goal: nothing gets through, all utility kept
